mapping.summary: Preventive and corrective maintenance, statutory inspections and certificates for production equipment.
claims: Preventive plans by time, counter, first-due or condition
Job queue creates work orders ahead with task checklists and a 12-month forecast
Failure codes based on ISO 14224 and downtime recording
Hours come from standard time sheets
Spare parts reserved from stock with lot and serial numbers; shortages to requisition worksheet
Contractor work goes to a purchase order
Permit to work with lockout-tagout gates
Parts, labor and contractor cost posted per equipment, optionally to the fixed asset
Statutory inspection rule sets for UK, EU, Greece, Cyprus, Italy, Germany and France
Calibration records as-found and as-left readings per test point
Finalised certificates are locked; changes need an amendment with reason
Premium: maintenance windows cut work center capacity
Production output posting updates equipment hours, cycles and tool wear
Warns on overdue certificates and worn tools when releasing production orders
KPIs for availability, MTBF, MTTR and downtime cost, with Power BI API pages
Comes with guided setup, demo data and Excel templates for import
